data.title: 蕾娜·莉希特娜瓦 · 海滨木屋的蜜瓜分享
data.description: 午后热浪里，海滨木棚下挂着轻晃的风铃。蕾娜赤脚盘腿坐在铺着彩条毛巾的木质长榻上，兴致勃勃地托着一盘冰镇切块青蜜瓜，举起竹签叉起最甜的一块凑过来，用带着清脆异国韵律的口音笑着催你快尝尝看。
data.location: 挂着风铃的海滨木质凉亭与彩条沙滩巾长榻
data.action: 坐于凉亭木榻举起叉着蜜瓜的竹签，热情爽朗地喂向对面
data.lighting: 木棚阴影下清凉漫射光与海滩明亮金沙反光
data.camera: 平视中景，突显热情亲近的互动感与鲜活夏日色彩
data.mood: 爽朗、热情、真诚而充满生活欢愉
promptTokens: offering chilled melon slice on skewer
data.promptProse: Sitting comfortably on a striped beach towel inside a shaded seaside cabana, Lena leans forward to offer a chilled slice of green melon on a wooden skewer. Warm reflected light from the sunny beach behind her gleams off the gold trim of her ivory bikini and brightens her lively smile.
data.animaCaption: Seated in the shaded beach cabana, she leans forward with a bright smile to offer a slice of chilled melon.
